profiles.text: Queens Nursery grows Tennessee-native perennials, grasses, shrubs, and trees for pollinator gardens in the Memphis area. Plants are available through appointments, farmers markets, and seasonal sales listed on its official storefront.

imagePreference: Nursery/greenhouse first, requested official logos retained, plants next. Avoid people-focused images and unrelated stock portraits.
